summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The HCM Defender 500 Index ETF (LGH) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the HCM Defender 500 index. The fund tracks a proprietary index that toggles between US large-cap stocks and Treasurys, or a combination of both, depending on risk in the US equity market. LGH was launched on Oct 10, 2019 and is issued by HCM.

holdings.infoBox: LGH is an equity ETF with a total of 419 individual holdings. The top holdings are Direxion Daily S&P 500 Bull 3X ETF stock at 19.80%, NVIDIA at 7.23%, Apple at 6.97%, Microsoft at 5.14%, and Alphabet at 4.91%.
